requirements.description: User wants properties near public transport. Per the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71), the property should be in the top quartile for transport accessibility.

User prefers energy class C or better, so the energy class is restricted to A1-A4, B and C. The 140 sqm floor area, 18-person capacity, Turin location and proximity to public transport are not available columns and are not filtered here.

output.explanation: Filters residential dwellings (continuous residence) with surface_area >= 140 sqm, energy_class A1-A4/B/C, mobility score >= 71, and within 3.0 km of the given coordinates. Results are ordered by haversine distance from the center point. No comune_code predicate is used, since the place name is not a cadastral code.
